description: Differences between a generated config and its Builder re-export that are expected: values the Builder recomputes on export, not losses. Each pattern is a regular expression matched against a diff line 'config: <path>: <input> → <export>' or 'map: <path>: ...'. Every other difference fails the round-trip: it is a value the generator wrote and the Builder drops or changes. Add an entry only with the place in the Builder code that explains it.

entries.reason: Canonical contributor identifier, and name/title/icon copied from the widget (config-export-helper getAnalyticsContributor / map contributor identifier = collection).
Swimlane name copied from the widget title.
Widget input.id follows the canonical identifier, and is not exported for metric / powerbars / metricstable.
Component uuid regenerated by the Builder.
useUtc only exported for time histograms.
metricstable: the collection is carried by configuration[].collection.
Layer source names are canonical (feature-<geometry>-<mode>-<collection>) and include_fields is rebuilt from the layer style (config-export-helper.ts:359,688,725).
Same canonical source names in config.map.json.
Hover / select layers are rebuilt from their base layer (config-map-export-helper.ts:168).
Display name comes from the collection description, empty in the test mocks.
isScrollableLayer is only exported for feature layers (config-map-export-helper.ts:216).
onHover / emitOnClick recomputed from the layers (config-export-helper.ts:622).
Exported from mainFormService.configurationName, set when the dashboard is saved (empty in the test).
